entry.title: Guangzhou International Finance Center
entry.note: Fresh OSM whole 184738716 confirms Q1043438 and the unequal rounded triangular corners, matching the independently stored prior outline to sub-millimeter precision. Retain signed heading 0.383087548587 and anchor [113.317930364,23.120231195]; +X east-northeast, +Z south-southeast. Native helipad [-17,-7] projects almost due west, consistent with the architect Opera House photograph and plan/elevation, while its exact center and the north frontage canopy remain reconstructions. Source Y=0 is reconstructed street grade; CVU 438.6 m tip/437.5 m landing plane override mapped 440.2 m. Curved interpolation and lower swelling may extend beyond the mapped ground polygon. Accept 2 m main-envelope/1 degree reconstruction allowance, excluding projecting canopy and reconstructed helipad; no automatic footprint replacement. Separate mall/apartment annex and landscape are excluded from this tower asset. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
